steps.text: Raising the pool on a checkout service under load. Looks routine — the chart takes the value and it goes through pgbouncer.

steps.headline: The pool value is IGNORED unless pgbouncer.customIni is set
steps.detail: The pgbouncer upgrade resets the pool config to defaults. Setting the helm value alone does nothing — it is silently discarded unless pgbouncer.customIni is also set. This is what took checkout down.
steps.author: priya.raman

second.headline: We hit this same trap in 2023
second.author: marco.velten

steps.text: Stopping. This change does not do what it looks like it does.

Your edit raises poolSize to {{new}}, but that value is discarded on this chart unless pgbouncer.customIni is set. You would ship a change that appears to work, and the pool would stay at the default — which is exactly how checkout went down 8 months ago.
steps.fix: Set pgbouncer.customIni alongside it, or the edit is a no-op.

steps.text: Pointing checkout straight at the primary. That removes a hop, so latency should improve.

steps.headline: Checkout must not connect straight to the primary
steps.detail: At 6 replicas the primary runs out of connection slots before the pooler does. The comment in this file — 'See the deploy review note before changing this' — points at the review where that was decided.
steps.author: marco.velten

steps.text: Stopping. There is a decision on this line.
